title: Ascalon
summary: Ascalon is a spear-like artifact first seen in The Fire of Georgiopolis. According to Gil, if the Organization had been able to get ahold of it, the Huntik Foundation would have been in real trouble. The spear is split in two items: a spearhead and a lance.
full_text: Ascalon is a spear-like artifact first seen in The Fire of Georgiopolis. According to Gil, if the Organization had been able to get ahold of it, the Huntik Foundation would have been in real trouble. The spear is split in two items: a spearhead and a lance.[The Fire of Georgiopolis]
